race.comment: BRIDEGO (4) has been showing good tactical speed and comes through some strong form races. Expecting him to push forward again and give backers a sight. DARK JUSTICE (5) has improved at each start this campaign, specifically last time when beaten less than a length at Scone. If he can build off that again, he can give this a shake. MAMMA MIA (9) is knocking on the door and has been freshened. Can fill a spot in the frame. BONJOUR BILL (3) came through two hot maidens before claiming a CL1 at Taree last time. Needs to go up another rung but deserves each-way respect.
